An '''eatery''' selling [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages, including a locally-produced [[Abraxin beer|beer]] as well as [[Abraxin Brandy]], was established by<ref name="DarthP" /> [[67 BBY/Legends|67]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> at a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Unidentified Barabel settlement|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]].<ref name="DarthP" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The eatery was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DarthP" />
